name: Life spaceship 148310e3 on 3-uniform tiling k3-041
description: A period-4 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-041, with touching neighbours, 12 to 19 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 16,384 rules from B3/S23 to B3,8,9,10,11,12,13,14/S2,3,8,9,10,11,12,13,14. JETCARP's Life census met it in 150 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
